dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Dogecoin is a cryptocurrency that started as a comic meme in 2013, using a Shiba Inu.  It is primarily known as a friendly and frivolous currency, but has grown in popularity over time.  Elon Musk has promoted it a lot through his tweets, which has also increased its price.
